entries.title: Review Finding Grades
entries.compatibility: Additive multi-source grades with immutable source keys; explicit historical backfill and atomic batch settlement writes. Explicit manifest remediation consumes grades; no live review or merge predicate consumes them. Backfill excludes decisions already graded at settlement; lifecycle grade kind agrees across paths. Projection/backfill writers acquire IMMEDIATE write locks before reads; finding and grade backfills commit per pass and optionally report committed inserts through onPass. Safe live finding projection retries busy once.

entries.title: Review Finding Records
entries.store: data/reviews.db: review_findings, review_finding_replies, review_finding_remediations, review_finding_disputes, finding_backlog, finding_batches, finding_batch_notes, finding_batch_releases
entries.owner: review-body capture and remediation completion observations
entries.compatibility: FINDINGSSTUCK-01: additive replay-safe finding_batches.batch_attempts counts returned invalid initial receipts separately from per-finding release attempts. Failed dispatch subprocesses preserve that counter and retry the same batch/key without a finding charge. Legacy ambiguous errors reset the old counter once. Overdue retries report needs-operator; actual releases retain their existing requeue/exhaustion audit. Projection/backfill writers acquire IMMEDIATE write locks before reads; finding and grade backfills commit per pass and optionally report committed inserts through onPass. Safe live finding projection retries busy once. Historical projections insert historical_projection=1 on findings and notes; automatic candidate views exclude them, while explicit manifests retain enrollment authority. Automatic claims use the configured source merge-age window; summaries expose outOfWindow without mutating skipped rows. Historical body repair and link CLI use the same projection marker; a genuine live projection can activate matching historical observations, including at verified merge capture.
